end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants.
Answered that the cell is the smallest unit of life.
Correctly explained that the circulatory system includes the heart, blood, and vessels.
Ordered muscle cell → muscle tissue → stomach → digestive system → human.
Needed repeated prompting to recall the full level order; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Yash practised giving examples for each level of organisation and ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism. They used the heart and circulatory system to explain that an organ system has several organs and parts working together, and later gave the full human example in the correct order. At home, ask them to arrange the five levels using one human example and one plant example, then explain why each level comes before the next.
